name: sgs/icon-list
title: SGS Icon List
description: List with custom icons or checkmarks per item.

wrapper.label: List wrapper
wrapper._note: The root <ul>. `gap` is a spacing preset slug ("20") or a custom length ("11px"), validated by sgs_css_length_value() and emitted as the `--sgs-icon-list-gap` custom-property VALUE (contract-permitted, not a declaration). No __experimentalBorder.width/color/style native support declared — border-width/style/colour are SGS custom scalar attrs (base only, no tiers), mirrors sgs/quote's borderWidth object pattern. No `layer` — this is a static list, not a configurable grid/flex composite (no display/flex-*/grid-* attrs exist).

item-icon.label: Item icon
item-icon._note: Per-item icon span (`.sgs-icon-list__icon`). `css:color` resolves via default convention `icon`+`Colour`=`iconColour` — font-size/weight/line-height/etc are honest gaps, an icon glyph has no typography surface. iconSize/defaultIconSource are bespoke icon-source controls with no cluster member and surface as orphans, not gaps. `css:stroke` (icon/SVG gradient mechanism) is explicit-mapped to `iconColourGradient` — non-empty wins over iconColour's flat currentColor paint at render time (helpers-svg-gradient.php).

item.label: Item row
item._note: The per-item `<li class="sgs-icon-list__item">` row (`$item_row_sel`, fed to `sgs_typography_css_rule( $attributes, 'item', $item_row_sel )` — the shared TypographyControls emitter). Owns itemFontSize/FontSizeUnit/FontWeight/FontStyle/LineHeight/LineHeightUnit, all resolved via the default `item`+suffix convention. This is a DISTINCT DOM node from item-text's `<span class="sgs-icon-list__text">` (`$text_sel`). The item-row's itemFontSize/itemLineHeight family belongs to this element, not item-text. Same split rationale as the `heading` element below.

item-text.label: Item text
item-text._note: Per-item text span (render.php, `.sgs-icon-list__text`). Typography routes through the shared TypographyControls `textEl` target + sgs_typography_css_rule( $attributes, 'textEl', $text_sel ), so `prefix` is `"textEl"` and the default `{prefix}{suffix}` convention resolves fontSize/lineHeight/textAlign/etc via textElFontSize/textElLineHeight/textElTextAlign directly, no explicit mapping needed. Colour is its own explicit mapping (textColour, unprefixed — independent of the textEl typography prefix).

heading.label: Heading
heading._note: Optional list heading (`.sgs-icon-list__heading`). Custom typography resolves via prefix `heading` + the text cluster (headingFontSize/FontWeight/FontStyle/LineHeight). Declared as its OWN element so heading* typography routes to element=heading, DISTINCT from item* text.

item-dimmed.label: Dimmed sibling item
item-dimmed._note: Wave 3C U-6, M-24: every OTHER item in the same list while one is hovered or keyboard-focused (a list-scoped :has() rule, includes/helpers-item-effects.php::sgs_sibling_dim_css). itemMotionDuration/itemMotionEasing are the ONE shared item-motion pair (sibling dim, label roll, ornament crossfade); explicit because the {prefix}{suffix} convention cannot derive them.

item-number.label: Item number
item-number._note: Wave 3C U-7, M-22: the ::marker of a `numbered` list item (a real <ol>).

item-link.label: Item link
item-link._note: The per-item link (`a.sgs-icon-list__item-link`, and any link in an item's text). How it is underlined is chosen with sgs_link_underline_css() from render.php, called as sgs_link_underline_css( $attributes, '', $root_sel . $root_sel ).

item-description.label: Item description
item-description._note: The optional second line under an item's text (render.php, `.sgs-icon-list__description`). Typography routes through TypographyControls' `description` target + sgs_typography_css_rule( $attributes, 'description', ... ), so the {prefix}{suffix} convention resolves descriptionFontSize etc.

sibling-dim.reason: The row IS a pointer-driven state: its colour paints the OTHER items only while one item is hovered or keyboard-focused (a list-scoped :has() rule). There is no resting moment for it to differ from, so a separate Hover swatch would describe nothing.

linkUnderline.description: How the list's links are underlined: '' the theme's underline and site-wide link sweep, none, always, or sweep (a line sweeps in on hover and keyboard focus). sgs_link_underline_css().

linkUnderlineThickness.description: Thickness of the link underline for always and sweep (a CSS length); empty uses the theme's link-sweep thickness or the browser's.

separators.description: The lines drawn between the list's items (the shared Separators setting, includes/helpers-separators.php): { row: { style, width: {desktop,tablet,mobile}, colour }, edges: between | all | end }. A horizontal line centred in the gap between stacked items, drawn by the items; edges `all` also draws the line above the first item and below the last, `end` only below the last. No thickness (the default) draws nothing; no colour inherits the text colour.

iconColour.description: Per-item icon colour override. Empty falls back to the block-level iconColour.

iconColourGradient.description: Per-item icon gradient override. Empty falls back to the block-level iconColourGradient. Non-empty wins over this item's own iconColour.

iconColourHover.description: Per-item icon hover-colour override. Empty falls back to the block-level iconColourHover.

iconColourGradientHover.description: Per-item icon hover-gradient override. Empty falls back to the block-level iconColourHoverGradient. Non-empty wins over this item's own iconColourHover.

description.description: Optional second line under this item's text (a smaller, muted description). Empty renders nothing.

siteInfoSource.description: Where this item takes its text from: empty (the typed text) or phone | email | address | hours, read from Site Info and shown as sgs/business-info shows it. A blank Site Info value hides the item. No enum: render.php allow-lists it, so an unknown value falls back to the typed text.

siteInfoLink.description: Site Info items only. Address: link to the Site Info Maps link. Opening hours: link to the item's typed url, else the Google Business profile. Phone and email always link.

newTab.description: Open this item's link in a new tab.

defaultIconSource._comment: The values are the framework's icon-source vocabulary, enforced as a hard allow-list in icon/render.php (`$allowed_sources = array( 'lucide', 'wp-icon', 'dashicon', 'emoji' )`) and mirrored one-for-one by the four icon-* roles on sgs/icon (iconName/wpIconName/dashiconName/emojiChar). sgs/icon.iconSource declares this identical enum. Feeds enum_values -> TIER 3.5 role `enum-mode`, and gives the client a real select control.

iconColourGradient.description: CSS gradient string painting every item's icon stroke instead of a flat colour. Non-empty wins over iconColour at render time.

iconColourHoverGradient.description: Hover-state gradient sibling of iconColourGradient. Non-empty wins over iconColourHover at render time.

iconBackgroundColour.description: Fills a circle behind each item's icon (e.g. a soft beige circle with a dark tick). Empty = no circle.

iconBoxSize.description: Diameter of the icon background circle. Empty resolves to 26px when `iconBackgroundColour` is set; has no effect otherwise.

itemPaddingBlock.description: Vertical padding (top and bottom) inside each item row, e.g. for breathing room on a divided list.

borderColourGradient.description: CSS gradient string painting the border instead of a flat colour. Non-empty wins over borderColour at render time.

siblingDimColour.description: Wave 3C U-6, M-24 (.claude/reports/2026-09-25-u6-u7-design.md 3c). Text colour of the OTHER items in the same list while one is hovered or keyboard-focused. '' off.

siblingDimColourGradient.description: Gradient sibling of siblingDimColour (text-gradient trio: background-clip:text with a first-stop fallback). Non-empty wins over the flat colour.

siblingDimOpacity.description: Wave 3C U-6, M-24. Opacity (0 to 1) of the other items in the same list while one is hovered or keyboard-focused. Unset off.

labelRoll.description: Wave 3C U-6, M-25 (.claude/reports/2026-09-25-u6-u7-design.md 3d). Two-copy label roll on hover or keyboard focus: '' off (no extra markup), `up` (the label rolls up to a copy of itself), `up-scale` (the outgoing copy also shrinks to 0.8). Honours reduced motion.

itemMotionDuration.description: Wave 3C U-6 (.claude/reports/2026-09-25-u6-u7-design.md 3c). ONE item-motion time in ms (0 to 3000) shared by this block's item effects (sibling dim, label roll, the ornament crossfade). Unset resolves to 300.

itemMotionEasing.description: Item-motion easing curve, from the shared motion easing list (includes/helpers-motion-easing.php).

itemMotionEasingCustom.description: A hand-typed `cubic-bezier(x1, y1, x2, y2)` curve, read only when `itemMotionEasing` is `custom` (validated by sgs_motion_valid_cubic_bezier).

numberFormat.description: Wave 3C U-7, M-22 (.claude/reports/2026-09-25-u6-u7-design.md 3g). Number style of a `numbered` list: 1, 2 … or 01, 02 …

numberColour.description: Colour of a `numbered` list's numbers. A drawer's sub-item marker colour takes precedence when this list renders inside a mega panel in the drawer.

numberFontSize.description: Font size of a `numbered` list's numbers.

numberFontWeight.description: Font weight of a `numbered` list's numbers.

source._comment: The values are the allow-list render.php enforces: `in_array( $attributes['source'] ?? '', array( 'typed', 'menu' ), true ) ? ... : 'typed'`. Declaring it does three things at once with no new role logic: /sgs-update Stage 1 reads it into block_attributes.enum_values, TIER 3.5 then seeds role `enum-mode` from that column, and the client gets a real select control instead of a free-text box (Spec 35 Part B). WP coercing an out-of-enum stored value back to the default matches render.php's own fallback exactly, so the two layers agree rather than diverge.

descriptionColour.description: Colour of each item's description line. Empty keeps the muted default.
